title: Not strong at all
text: Not strong at all. I open first bag and there was a thread hanging. So I just tugged it. If I pulled it all the way. The whole seam was going to open up. The lg bag was supposed to be 15 inches or 40 cm. Its maybe 12. The angle cut on the top makes it smaller. The top opening looks like about 8 inches. You get stronger bags at the supermarket. Very disappointed. Sending back!
